query:
UPDATE identity.people
            SET civility = nullif(btrim($2), ''),
                first_name = btrim($3),
                last_name = btrim($4),
                job_title = nullif(btrim($5), ''),
                phone = nullif(btrim($6), ''),
                country_id = $7,
                city = nullif(btrim($8), ''),
                preferred_locale = $9,
                timezone = $10::text::platform.timezone_name,
                is_directory_visible = $11
          WHERE id = $1
